# PreIPOKart

> PreIPOKart is an Indian marketplace where people buy and sell shares in private companies before those companies list on a stock exchange.

## What the product is

Investors browse well-known private companies, place a buy or sell request at a price and quantity they choose, and wait for a match. Money is held until the deal is done. The product is aimed at everyday investors in India.

PreIPOKart is not:

- a recognised stock exchange
- an NSE or BSE broker
- a source of live listed-market quotes
- a guaranteed counterparty

Prices shown on the home page and on a company page are last-traded or indicative.

## How a visit works

1. Home (https://preipokart.in/) explains the product and shows a sample of companies.
2. Companies (https://preipokart.in/explore) is the full book. Visitors can search, filter by sector, and sort by percent change, price, or name.
3. A company page is /stocks/{id}. It shows the company, price, and financials. If that id is missing, the visitor is sent to /explore.
4. Placing an order requires an account. Sign up is https://preipokart.in/signup (name, email, password). Log in is https://preipokart.in/login.
5. After sign-in, the investor can use the dashboard, portfolio, orders, and profile (KYC, demat, nominee). Those screens are private.

## Missing pages

Any address that is not a real page redirects to https://preipokart.in/explore.

The same redirect is used when:

- a company id does not exist
- a blog slug does not exist
- a legal policy slug does not exist

## Public pages

- [Home](https://preipokart.in/): Product introduction and sample companies.
- [Companies](https://preipokart.in/explore): The unlisted book, and the fallback for missing pages.
- [IPOs](https://preipokart.in/ipos): Public issues, including upcoming and open offers. These are separate from unlisted shares.
- [Blog](https://preipokart.in/blog): Market notes. Individual posts are /blog/{slug}.
- [FAQ](https://preipokart.in/faq): Questions about buying, selling, KYC, and fees.
- [Help](https://preipokart.in/help): Short product help.
- [Contact](https://preipokart.in/contact): Office in Bengaluru and a contact form. Email hello@preipokart.in.
- [Careers](https://preipokart.in/careers): Open jobs. Email careers@preipokart.in.
- [Terms of use](https://preipokart.in/legal/terms): Platform rules.
- [Privacy policy](https://preipokart.in/legal/privacy): Personal data used for KYC and settlement.
- [Sign up](https://preipokart.in/signup): Create an account.
- [Log in](https://preipokart.in/login): Open an existing account.
- [Sitemap](https://preipokart.in/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable list of public URLs.
- [Short LLM guide](https://preipokart.in/llms.txt): The concise version of this file.

## Private screens

Do not treat these as public documents. They require a signed-in investor:

- /dashboard
- /portfolio
- /orders and /orders/{id}
- /place-order
- /profile
- /notifications
- /kyc (opens profile KYC)
- /biometric (opens profile)

- Site: https://preipokart.in

- Careers: careers@preipokart.in
- API: https://api.preipokart.in/v1
